hook: Meta is putting full autonomous AI agents inside your glasses.
spoken_script: Meta is putting full autonomous AI agents inside your glasses. At Connect 2026, Meta unveiled Muse, powered by the new Muse Spark 1.3 model with a one million token context window. Muse does not just answer questions—it books travel, manages schedules, and runs real-time voice translation across fourteen languages. Meta also introduced Ray-Ban Meta Audio and previewed one-hundred-gram spatial glasses. Follow AI News Factory for daily verified AI breakthroughs.
